purpose: Phase 1E: clear exactly the three Phase 1D freeze blockers. No predictive research; only correctness fixes needed to clear these blockers are permitted.

current_blockers.R11: simulation N engineering audit: N=25,000 failed C3 (max empirical tail-probability sd across 4 repeats 0.0059-0.0068 vs 0.005) and C4 (p95 repeat instability of median/p90 0.053-0.056 vs 0.05) in n_engineering_audit.json
current_blockers.S1: live end-to-end operation not shown: retrieval exercised only against a local mirror, no real-provider fetch, no scheduler, no real-timing rehearsal
current_blockers.S2: v2 incumbent forward logging: no frozen, immutable, pre-kickoff v2 forecast log exists

forbidden: inspecting outcomes of live rehearsal games for any choice (they are quarantined until after the final freeze decision)

R11_simulation_N.reuse_unchanged: the predetermined burned weeks, outcomes, repeat design (4 repeats with different seeds + one independent reference run), engineering criteria C1-C4 and reference methodology of nfl_models/nfl_player_outcome_phase1d/n_engineering_criteria.json (same script nfl_phase1d_nengineering.py with only the candidate N changed; reference N = 100,000 independent seed)
R11_simulation_N.selection_rule: choose the smallest N in [50,000, 100,000] that passes ALL of C1, C2, C3, C4; if 50,000 passes select it and STOP (100,000 is not run); if 50,000 fails run 100,000; if 100,000 fails R11 remains BLOCKER
R11_simulation_N.not_allowed: comparing N by MAE, CRPS against actual outcomes or any football accuracy; changing any criterion
record: mean and p95 normalized mean / median / p10 / p90 instability
R11_simulation_N.pass_condition: R11 PASS iff a candidate N passes C1, C2, C3 and C4

S1_real_provider.registry: live_source_registry.json: every consumed source with provider, canonical endpoint, schema, parser version, cadence, lag, required at T24 / T90, failure policy; no silent substitution of a development source
S1_real_provider.fetch_test: contact the REAL providers (no local mirror, no copied or cached development file): retrieve, record real retrieval timestamp, sha256 of raw bytes, store in CAS, parse with the frozen parser, validate schema, report latest season / week / date represented and freshness vs now; output real_provider_fetch_audit.json
S1_real_provider.provider_lag_policy: use the latest bytes actually obtainable before the cutoff and record their age; never retrieve a later revision and label it T24 / T90; operational staleness limits (schedule must contain the target game with current kickoff; completed games whose ingestion deadline passed must be present) -> otherwise SAFE_EXPLICIT_FAILURE; no invented data
S1_real_provider.scheduler: dispatcher that inspects the snapshotted schedule, finds upcoming cutoffs, executes exactly once per game and horizon (T24, T90), persists decisions, survives restart, never duplicates, logs MISSED_REAL_CUTOFF, never backdates; shadow infrastructure only
S1_real_provider.live_cutoff_rehearsal: use real upcoming games from the real schedule; a snapshot counts only if physically retrieved BEFORE its real cutoff; a cutoff already passed is MISSED_REAL_CUTOFF (no backfill pretending to be live) and the next future cutoff is used; no outcome needed
S1_real_provider.end_to_end: real provider -> CAS -> verified snapshots -> LiveLoader -> walk-forward bundle -> Phase 1C simulator (chosen N) -> calibration -> forecast records -> board; then rerun: 0 new forecasts, all existing verified identical; restart / crash behaviour must still work; NOT clean-forward evidence
S1_real_provider.pass_condition: S1 PASS iff every required source is retrieved reliably from the real provider with a valid schema, the scheduler is demonstrated (including restart safety), and at least one genuine pre-cutoff end-to-end rehearsal (snapshot retrieved before the real cutoff, complete provenance, idempotent rerun) succeeds. If a required source cannot be retrieved reliably, or no genuine future cutoff can be rehearsed, S1 remains BLOCKER

S2_v2_comparator.frozen_comparator_definition: v2_frozen_comparator = the nfl_yardage_v2 recipe (v2.FEATURES, v2.PARAMS, objective reg:absoluteerror) for rushing and receiving yards, trained on rows through 2024 wk12 and early-stopped on 2024 wk13-18 (the honest refit used in Phase 1C), saved as artifact files with sha256; point = the model median forecast; residual distribution = empirical residuals on 2024 wk13-18 added to the point forecast and floored at 0; eligibility = the v2 recipe's own (prior-usage thresholds of v2 MARKETS); no refit in the forward window unless pre-registered. It is frozen at the Phase 1 freeze.
three_fields: v2_live_production (operational context only; whatever v2 production artifact is serving, may differ)
S2_v2_comparator.sportsbook_use: bookmaker spread / total are v2 INPUTS and are read only by the v2 comparator logger from a separate raw schedule snapshot; Phase 1 never reads them
S2_v2_comparator.logger: append-only, same-id/same-bytes verified duplicate, same-id/different-bytes HARD ERROR; fields: forecast_id, game_id, player_id, name, outcome, horizon, forecast timestamp, kickoff, artifact hash, code hash, point prediction, residual-distribution hash, quantiles, input hashes, eligibility / abstention reason
S2_v2_comparator.time_travel_equivalence: over multiple burned weeks the logger's point predictions equal the honest v2-refit implementation within 1e-9; target-game outcome perturbation leaves the pregame v2 forecast unchanged; prior-history perturbation changes later v2 forecasts where expected
S2_v2_comparator.pass_condition: S2 PASS iff the frozen artifact + hashes exist, time-travel equivalence and both perturbation tests pass, the log is immutable and idempotent, the v2 forecast of a genuine real pre-kickoff rehearsal is generated and stored before kickoff, and Phase 1 / v2 common-player matching is deterministic

decision_rule: READY_FOR_FINAL_FREEZE_AUDIT only if R11, S1, S2 are PASS, every Phase 1D PASS item still PASSES and no new correctness blocker exists; otherwise NOT_READY with the exact remaining blockers. The final freeze file is never created by Phase 1E.
quarantine: outcomes of any live rehearsal game that become available before Phase 1E ends are not scored or inspected
freeze_candidate: nfl_player_outcome_phase1_freeze_candidate_v3.json and freeze_candidate_validation_v3.md (PASS / BLOCKER only; the three blockers evaluated as R11, S1, S2; any new correctness failure is added explicitly with evidence)
